whatItDoes: Pi AskUserQuestion gives the model a structured tool for pausing work and collecting user choices before it continues.
Each call can present one to four questions, support single or multiple selections, and accept a typed answer without requiring the model to invent an extra option.

whenToReachForIt.invocation: Ask the model to clarify requirements or preferences; the model invokes the structured question tool.

situations.when: Several valid implementation paths need an explicit user choice
situations.use: Present concise options and return the selected label to the model.

situations.when: More than one answer may apply
situations.use: Use a multi-select question and combine checked options with optional typed input.

situations.when: A larger request has a few independent decisions
situations.use: Group up to four questions into tabs and review every answer before submission.

whatItAdds: One model-invoked tool with bounded question and option schemas.
An interactive terminal component for option selection, typed answers, answer review, cancellation, and compact result rendering.

questions.question: What happens outside an interactive session?
answer: The call returns an error, marks the result cancelled, and removes the question tool from active tools for the rest of that session.

questions.question: Can users provide an answer not listed by the model?
answer: Yes. The component adds its own typed-answer row, so callers should provide only real choices rather than adding an Other option.

workingIf: The terminal opens the question view and returns selected or typed answers to the model.
Duplicate question text or duplicate labels are rejected before the interactive view opens.
setupNotes: Created and maintained by Baishampayan Ghose; installed directly from the original repository.
